external.note: Background Blender only (blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 2) runs mesh_dump.py, organic_unwrap.py, organic_apply.py and uv_eval_blender.py; uv_eval.py finds it through the companion skill's blender_env.py (--blender-exe, --local-config FILE with tools.blender.path, BLENDER, PATH, the standard install folder). SLIM (MINIMUM_STRETCH) needs Blender 4.3 or newer; every number in the references was measured on Blender 5.1.2. No live session is used.
Host Python 3.9+ runs seam_plan.py, organic_layout.py, island_priority.py, uv_draw.py, compare_runs.py and uv_gates.py and launches the background Blender stages.
Host Python package; Blender bundles its own numpy for the Blender stages.
organic_layout.py's raster packer (FFT collision test, distance-transform gutter halo).
Island rasterisation in the packer and every evaluator picture (uv_draw.py, compare_runs.py).
The tests/ suites; test_blender_pipeline.py skips when no Blender is found, the other three run anywhere.
A gate profile measured on the consuming game's shipped units. Kept in that game's layer: a filled copy of profiles/template_unit_body.json (references/gates.md says how to derive it).

Posed visibility at the game camera: either an armature action in the .blend (uv_eval --pose-frame/--pose-action) or a pose NPZ written by the game layer's pose simulator (--pose-npz, format in scripts/README.md). Without it the bind pose is used and visible-seam numbers are not comparable with the profile.

Consumer-provided phase-handoff contract and writer, not bundled. In this library it is hosted by the hard-surface texturing package: blender-architecture-texturing/references/handoff-contract.md and blender-architecture-texturing/scripts/handoff.py.
